671-1981-5147.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing any other creature you control.
When the creature dies, Daxos triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to yourself.
Darien triggers, causing you to create a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Daxos triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.

339-677-5223-8227.notablePrerequisites: You have at least seven cards in your graveyard.
339-677-5223-8227.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Loot by sacrificing Jegantha, giving Loot -2/-0 until end of turn
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

1531-4279-7316--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
1531-4279-7316--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Deathgreeter, Rat King and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Deathgreeter trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Rat King ability, creating a 1/1 Rat creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Deathgreeter triggers, causing you to gain 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

2585-4574-4659-5283-6842.notablePrerequisites: There must be at least one +1/+1 counter each on Arcbound Reclaimer and at least two additional artifacts.
2585-4574-4659-5283-6842.description:
Cast Grim Monolith by paying its mana cost.
When you cast that spell, Inexorable Tide triggers, putting one +1/+1 counter on Arcbound Reclaimer and at least two additional artifacts you control.
Activate Grim Monolith by tapping it, adding mana.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Grim Monolith, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Arcbound Reclaimer by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting Grim Monolith from your graveyard on top of your library.
Activate Iron Spider's last ability by paying {2} and removing two +1/+1 counters from artifacts you control, drawing Grim Monolith.
Repeat.

553-4586-5049.description:
During the opponent's end step immediately before your turn, cast Approach of the Second Sun by paying {6}{W} using Leyline of Anticipation.
In response, cast Endless Detour by paying its mana cost, putting Approach of the Sun on top of your library.
In your draw step, draw Approach of the Second Sun.
Cast Approach of the Second Sun by paying {6}{W}, winning the game.

215-527-5295.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with power 6 or greater.
215-527-5295.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {2}{G}{G}{G}{G}
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Selvala from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Selvala by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

4377-7715-7722.easyPrerequisites: The Mighty Thor doesn't have summoning sickness.
4377-7715-7722.description:
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying its mana cost.
Thor's second ability triggers, dealing damage to any target.
Resolve Walk the Aeons, causing you to take an extra turn after this one
Blink Thor using The Mighty Thor.
When Thor enters, it triggers, exiling Walk the Aeons from your graveyard and allowing you to cast it from exile until the end of your next turn.
Move to your next turn.
Cast Walk the Aeons from exile by paying its mana cost.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and without a -1/-1 counter on it

3099-4029-4762-6774.description:
Activate Leyline of Abundance by paying {6}{G}{G}, putting four +1/+1 counters on each creature you control due to Benevolent Hydra and Loading Zone.
Activate Devoted Druid's first ability by tapping it, adding {G}.
Leyline of Abundance triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping Devoted Druid.
Repeat from step 2 three additional times.
Repeat from step 1.

661-3581-3685-4659.description:
Cast Sculpting Steel by paying {3}.
Kykar triggers, creating a 1/1 Sprit creature token.
Resolve Sculpting Steel. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Spine of Ish Sah.
When Sculpting Steel enters, its first ability triggers, destroying a permanent.
Activate Kykar by sacrificing the Spirit, adding {R}.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Sculpting Steel, adding {C}{C}.
Sculpting Steel's second ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1171-1409-4460.description:
Activate Garth One-Eye by tapping it, casting a copy of Black Lotus by paying {0}.
Activate the Black Lotus token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Garth One-Eye by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Garth One-Eye enters, Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability triggers, repairing it and Garth One-Eye.
Repeat.

4200-4681-5686.description:
Cast Icewind Stalwart by paying its mana cost.
When Icewind Stalwart enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Karmic Guide
Holding priority, activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Icewind Stalwart.
Resolve the Icewind Stalwart ability, blinking Karmic Guide
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Icewind Stalwart from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

1605-2191-4416.notablePrerequisites: You are able to deal damage to a creature.
1605-2191-4416.description:
Cast Martyrdom by paying {1}{W}{W}, targeting Phyrexian Vindicator.
Activate Phyrexian Vindicator by paying {0}, targeting a creature.
Attempt to deal damage to the targeted creature. The damage will then be increased due to Gratuitous Violence, then redirected to Phyrexian Vindicator, which is then redirected back to the creature that was originally targeted.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Vindicator by paying {0}, targeting the creature. 
Repeat step 4 until all damage will be redirected to Phyrexian Vindicator.
Repeat from step 3.

2511-3652-4053-6989.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Ornithopter.
Cast Ornithopter from your graveyard by paying {0}. It will not enter with a finality counter on it due to Solemnity.
Repeat.

323-5073-5220-6900.description:
Activate Tinder Wall by sacrificing it.
When Tinder Wall dies, Mortuary and Falkenrath Noble trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Tinder Wall from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Falkenrath Noble trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Cast Tinder Wall from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

560-2034-5220-5631-6961.notablePrerequisites: You control ten or more lands that have different names.
560-2034-5220-5631-6961.description:
Activate Survey Mechan by sacrificing it.
When Survey Mechan dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Survey Mechan from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Skeleton Crew triggers, creating two creature tokens.
Resolve the Survey Mechan ability, dealing 3 damage to any target and causing you to draw three cards and gain 3 life.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the two creature tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Cast Survey Mechan by paying {4}.
Repeat.

515-1636-2872.description:
Activate the land with Squirrel Nest attached by tapping it, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
When the Squirrel enters, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Activate Clever Conjurer by tapping it, untapping the land with Squirrel Nest attached.
Repeat.

2292-2770-5571--6.description:
Donate Blightbeetle to an opponent
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the undying creature.
When the undying creature dies, its undying ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to Blightbeetle.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat from step 2.

1062-1742-3484-5674.notablePrerequisites: You have at least 3 land cards in your hand.
1062-1742-3484-5674.description:
Activate Skirge Familiar by discarding a land card.
Slogurk triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat from step 1 two additional times.
Activate Slogurk by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
When Slogurk leaves the battlefield, it triggers, returning three land cards from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Slogurk by paying {E} due to Primal Prayers.
When Slogurk enters, Decoction Module triggers, causing you to get {E}.
Repeat.

431-1308-2557-6753.notablePrerequisites: You control at least seven untapped Merfolk.
431-1308-2557-6753.description:
Whenever an opponent casts a spell, activate Lullmage Mentor by tapping seven untapped Merfolk, countering that spell.
Lullmage Mentor triggers, creating a total of eight 1/1 Merfolk creature tokens.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with six or more phyresis counters on it

3394-6249-6798--5.easyPrerequisites: The persist creature does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
3394-6249-6798--5.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, it and Weatherlight Compleated trigger.
Resolve the Weatherlight Compleated trigger, putting a phyresis counter on it and causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the persist creature's trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters the battlefield, Olivia triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature and causing you to discard a card.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

224-654-1772-3756.description:
Activate Zimone's first ability by paying {1} and tapping it, putting Izzet Boilerworks from your hand onto the battlefield untapped due to
When Izzet Boilerworks enters the battlefield, it, Amulet of Vigor and Retreat to Coralhelm trigger.
Resolve the Amulet of Vigor trigger, untapping Izzet Boilerworks
Holding priority, activate Izzet Boilerworks by tapping it, adding {U}{R}.
Resolve the Izzet Boilerworks trigger from step 2, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Zimone.
Repeat.

56-789-3220-5256.notablePrerequisites: You control an additional untapped black and/or green creature.
56-789-3220-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Hogaak.
When Hogaak dies, Golgari Germination and Gutter Grime trigger, creating two creature tokens.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing you to mill eight cards.
Cast Hogaak from your graveyard by exiling five cards from your graveyard and tapping two black and/or green creatures you control.
Repeat.
56-789-3220-5256.notes: Once you've milled your library, you may repeat the loop as the number of cards in your graveyard allows and decide to mill another player.

1987-2493-3542.notablePrerequisites: You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {2}{U}.
1987-2493-3542.description:
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Archaeomancer and Palinchron.
When Archaeomancer and Palinchron enter the battlefield, their abilities trigger.
Resolve the Archaeomancer trigger, returning Ghostly Flicker to your hand from your graveyard.
Resolve the Palinchron trigger, untapping up to seven lands.
Repeat.
If you control seven lands that can tap to produce at least {3}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana, and you may blink any other permanent besides Palinchron.

719-1821-3698-3764.description:
Activate Summoning Station by tapping it, creating a 2/2 Pincher creature token.
When the Pincher enters the battlefield as a Phyrexian due to Xenograft, Essence of Orthodoxy triggers, creating an Incubator artifact token.
When the Incubator enters the battlefield, Grinding Station triggers, untapping itself.
Activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing the Incubator.
Summoning Station triggers, untapping itself.
Resolve the Grinding Station ability, causing target player to mill three cards.
Repeat.

1374-1672-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Foulmire Knight, adding {B}.
Cast Foulmire Knight from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Repeat.

2103-3742-4477.notablePrerequisites: An opponent can not block Phantom Steed.
2103-3742-4477.description:
Cast Capture of Jingzhou, taking an extra turn after this one.
Attack with Phantom Steed.
Phantom Steed triggers, creating a token copy of Greenwarden of Murasa that is tapped and attacking.
Greenwarden of Murasa enters, returning Capture of Jingzhou from your graveyard to your hand.
Pass the turn.
Repeat.
